## Aston Villa predicted lineup

Aston Villa possible starting XI: Suzuki; Cash, Lindelof, Torres, Mings; Kamara, Barkley; McGinn, Buendia, Mbaye; Jackson

## When will the match kick off?

The Champions League match kicks off at 20:00 BST on Wednesday, 21 October 2026.

## How to watch Aston Villa vs Viking?

The match will be broadcast live on TNT Sports 2 and TNT Sports Ultimate in the UK. [...] Ian Maatsen is back in training after a month out, but Tyrone Mings may still be asked to play at left-back, with Matty Cash on the right. Villa's initial Champions League squad included only three recognised centre-backs, Victor Lindelof, Pau Torres and Mings, but Harwood-Bellis has been added through the replacement rule for Ruggeri. Hemmings is back in contention after a minor knee problem, while Nicolas Jackson, Tammy Abraham and Brian Madjo compete for the centre-forward role. Emery has [...] Advertisement

Viking are yet to win in the competition after a 3-1 defeat at Stuttgart and a 3-3 draw with Bayern. This is the first meeting between the clubs.

## Aston Villa team news

Manzambi, who was substituted in the 72nd minute at Newcastle on Saturday after scoring the winner, will not play. Emery said Wan-Bissaka will be out for "three or four weeks", Ruggeri for around two months and Onana for a long time. Modo Cisse is also out, according to Sports Mole.
